Completed November 2026

Villa Exterior Refresh, Los Dolses

A full outside makeover for a classic Spanish townhouse. We repainted the external and garden walls, brought the window guards and rails back to life, and installed a new 11 metre timber fence to give the terrace real privacy.

Scope
Exterior painting, ironwork, fencing
New fence
11 metres, timber
Location
Los Dolses, Costa Blanca
Time on site
8 days

What We Did

Three jobs, one tidy finish

External Walls

House walls, garden walls and raised planters prepared and painted in a bright, hard-wearing exterior white that stands up to the Costa Blanca sun.

Window Guards & Rails

Window guards, balcony rails and entrance stair railings cleaned back, treated and repainted for a sharp, even finish.

11m Timber Fence

A new 11 metre wooden fence installed around the terrace, giving the outdoor dining area privacy and a warm, natural backdrop.
